def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']
    k = inputs['k']
    
    # Josephus problem: eliminate every k-th person
    # Positions are 1-indexed
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current_pos = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Move k positions and remove
        current_pos = (current_pos + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current_pos)
        # Adjust position after removal
        if current_pos >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_pos = 0
    
    return float(people[0])

    steps = inputs['steps']
    
    # Apply xorshift transformation: X ^= (X<<11); X ^= (X>>9); X ^= (X<<15)
    # Keep all arithmetic within 32 bits
    mask = (1 << 32) - 1
    
    for _ in range(steps):
        X ^= (X << 11) & mask

        X ^= (X << 15) & mask
